instruction:
Rewrite the state layer of apps/web/src/hooks/use-task-filters-with-labels-support.ts per section 4 (4.1-4.7) of .sdlc/runs/20260904-061318-feature-extend-board-filter-chips/design.md.

Delete BOTH localStorage effects, the storageKey line and the useState. Derive filters from useSearch({ strict: false }) via decodeBoardFilters. Memoise on the FIVE EXTRACTED RAW STRINGS, not on the search object — memoising on the object churns filteredProject every render and trips Biome's useExhaustiveDependencies. Every mutator navigates with to: '.', a functional search updater, and replace: true. setFilters is the single primitive and must accept both a value and an updater function; updateFilter, updateLabelFilter and clearFilters delegate to it.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: the returned object must stay byte-identical in shape — { filters, setFilters, updateFilter, updateLabelFilter, filteredProject, hasActiveFilters, clearFilters }. updateLabelFilter STAYS exported with an unchanged signature. filterTasks and filteredProject are COPIED VERBATIM — AND across filter types, OR within a type, empty columns preserved. Zero behaviour change there. Rename the projectId param to _projectId (tsconfig sets noUnusedParameters).

Do NOT read localStorage at all — this is a clean cutover. Verify with: pnpm --filter @kaneo/web typecheck

every mutator navigates with replace: true and a functional search updater

instruction:
Replace EXACTLY TWO functions in apps/web/src/components/board/board-toolbar.tsx with the batched versions written out in sections 6.1 and 6.2 of .sdlc/runs/20260904-061318-feature-extend-board-filter-chips/design.md: toggleLabelGroup (currently lines 233-247) and clearLabelFilters (currently lines 249-252). Each must compute the full next label array and make ONE updateFilter('labels', next) call. Semantics must be preserved precisely: if any label in the colour group is selected, remove all of that group; otherwise add all of that group.

READ THIS BEFORE YOU SIMPLIFY ANYTHING. The hook's setFilters uses a FUNCTIONAL navigate search updater that decodes prev. That shape LOOKS like it would make N synchronous updateLabelFilter calls compose correctly. IT DOES NOT — each synchronous navigate() call resolves against the same committed router location, so the last write wins and a colour-group toggle would apply only ONE label. The batching in this file is the actual fix. Do NOT remove it, do NOT revert either function to a for-loop, do NOT conclude it is redundant.

Nothing else in this 676-line file changes. updateLabelFilter STAYS in BoardToolbarProps and stays imported/destructured even though these two sites no longer call it (see design section 6.3). Verify with: pnpm --filter @kaneo/web typecheck

inputs.reason: sections 6.1, 6.2, 6.3 give exact code and the do-not-simplify warning

acceptance: toggleLabelGroup contains no for-loop and makes exactly one updateFilter('labels', ...) call
clearLabelFilters makes exactly one updateFilter('labels', null) call
group toggle semantics preserved: any-selected => remove whole group, none-selected => add whole group
updateLabelFilter remains declared in BoardToolbarProps and destructured
no other line of the file changed
pnpm --filter @kaneo/web typecheck passes
